purpose: One integration test for AC-16103-4 driving rcf feedback add and rcf feedback list through bin/rcf.js in a real git repository with a linked worktree.
title: The feedback queue survives a removed git worktree: an entry recorded in a linked worktree is listed from the main checkout after git worktree remove

testCases.description: an entry rcf feedback add records in a linked git worktree is listed pending by rcf feedback list --json from the main checkout after git worktree remove
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-queue-survives.test.js::AC-16103-4: an entry rcf feedback add records in a linked git worktree is still listed pending by rcf feedback list from the main checkout after git worktree remove

testCases.description: a queue a linked worktree already holds is moved into the main checkout's store by the next rcf feedback command run there; after git worktree remove every entry, old and new, is listed from the main checkout exactly once with the status it had, and git status there lists nothing under .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-queue-migrates.test.js::AC-16103-4: a queue a linked worktree already holds is moved into the main checkout by the next rcf feedback command run there, and after git worktree remove every entry, old and new, is listed from the main checkout exactly once with the status it had

testCases.description: a main checkout whose .gitignore does not cover .rcf/feedback/: rcf feedback add in a linked worktree (no --force) exits 2 naming .rcf/feedback, rcf doctor --fix and the main checkout, and creates nothing under either checkout's .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-queue-migrates.test.js::AC-16103-4: when the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/ (the worktree branch does), rcf feedback add in a linked worktree refuses as AC-15501-2 refuses, names the main checkout, and writes nothing under either checkout

testCases.description: a main checkout without the rcf project: rcf feedback add in a linked worktree leaves nothing under .rcf/feedback/ in the main checkout's git status; an accepted entry is listed from the worktree, a refusal exits 2
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-queue-migrates.test.js::AC-16103-4: when the main checkout does not hold the rcf project (adopted on the worktree branch only), rcf feedback add in a linked worktree never leaves a file the main checkout would commit

testCases.description: a linked worktree that holds a queue while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/: rcf feedback list --all --json in the worktree lists both held entries with the status they had, the worktree entries.jsonl is byte-identical and nothing is created under the main checkout .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-unignored-main.test.js::AC-16103-4: while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/, a linked worktree that holds a queue keeps listing its own held entries with the status they had, and nothing moves

testCases.description: a linked worktree that holds a queue while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/: rcf feedback hook stop --harness claude-code with a new session_id in the worktree exits 2 with the ask counting the held pending entry, and nothing moves
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-unignored-main.test.js::AC-16103-4: while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/, the Stop hook in a linked worktree that holds a queue keeps asking about its held pending entries, and nothing moves

testCases.description: a linked worktree that holds a queue while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/: rcf feedback add (no --force) in the worktree exits 2, stderr naming .rcf/feedback, rcf doctor --fix, the main checkout and "the held entries move into the main checkout once it ignores .rcf/feedback/", and writes nothing under either checkout's .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-unignored-main.test.js::AC-16103-4: while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/, rcf feedback add in a linked worktree that holds a queue exits 2 naming the main checkout, rcf doctor --fix and that the held entries move once it ignores the store, and nothing moves

testCases.description: guard: once the main checkout ignores .rcf/feedback/, the next rcf feedback add in a worktree that held its queue while it did not moves that queue; after git worktree remove the main checkout lists every held entry and the new one, each id once with its status
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-unignored-main.test.js::AC-16103-4 guard: once the main checkout ignores .rcf/feedback/, the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree that held its queue while it did not moves that queue, and after git worktree remove every entry is listed from the main checkout once with the status it had

testCases.description: moving a worktree's held queue fails (the main checkout .rcf/ is not writable): rcf feedback add in the worktree exits non-zero, stderr naming the error (EACCES) and the main checkout, and the worktree .rcf/feedback/ is byte-identical (no new entry, nothing removed)
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-unignored-main.test.js::AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails, rcf feedback add in a linked worktree exits non-zero naming the error and the main checkout, writes nothing to the worktree queue and removes nothing it held

testCases.description: moving a worktree's held queue fails after appending to the main queue (the main checkout .rcf/feedback/state.json is read-only): rcf feedback add in the worktree exits 1, stderr naming the error (EACCES) and the main checkout, the worktree .rcf/feedback/ is byte-identical, the main checkout lists its own entry and every held entry once with its status; once the mode is restored the next command completes the move, and after git worktree remove every id is listed once and each held line is in the main entries.jsonl exactly once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-partial-move.test.js::AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails after appending to the main queue, rcf feedback add in a linked worktree exits 1 naming the error and the main checkout, the worktree keeps every file it held, the main checkout lists each id once, and the next command completes the move with each id once

testCases.description: moving a worktree's held queue fails after removing some held files (the worktree .rcf/feedback/outbox/ is read-only): rcf feedback list in the worktree exits 1, stderr naming the error (EACCES) and the main checkout, every held file it removed has its content in the main store, every file still held is byte-identical, the main checkout lists every held entry once with its status; once the mode is restored the next command completes the move, and after git worktree remove every id is listed once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-partial-move.test.js::AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails after removing some held files, rcf feedback list in a linked worktree exits 1 naming the error and the main checkout, every removed held file has its content in the main store, every file still held is byte-identical, and the next command completes the move with each id once

testCases.description: guard: the main checkout already holds the same entries.jsonl, state.json and outbox bundles (a SessionEnd bundle and a submit fallback bundle) as a linked worktree; the next rcf feedback command there exits 0 and removes every held file, each held line is in the main entries.jsonl once, each held ask record in the main state.json once, and each held bundle in the main outbox once at its own name under no second name
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-collision.test.js::AC-16103-4 guard: when the main checkout already holds the same entries.jsonl, state.json and outbox bundles (from the SessionEnd hook and from submit) as a linked worktree, the next rcf feedback command there removes every held file and copies nothing twice

testCases.description: guard: the main checkout holds an entry and a state.json of its own; the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree exits 0, removes the held state.json, keeps every ask record the main checkout had once and adds every held ask record once, and the main checkout lists every id once with its status
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-collision.test.js::AC-16103-4 guard: when the main checkout holds a state.json of its own, the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree merges every held ask record into the main state.json once and keeps every ask record the main checkout had

testCases.description: the main checkout outbox holds the name of each held bundle (the SessionEnd bundle and the submit fallback bundle) with different bytes: the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree exits 0, each held bundle is in the main outbox exactly once under a fresh name, each main bundle at the colliding name is byte-identical to before, no held file is left, the main checkout lists every id once with its status, git worktree remove succeeds and git status there lists nothing under .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-collision.test.js::AC-16103-4: when the main checkout outbox already holds the name of each held bundle (the SessionEnd and the submit fallback bundle) with different bytes, the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree exits 0, keeps each held bundle under a fresh name in the main outbox, leaves each main bundle byte-identical and removes every held file

testCases.description: as the bundle collision, plus a second held bundle that cannot be removed (macOS chflags uchg) so the move fails after removing the collided held bundle: rcf feedback list in the worktree exits 1 naming the error (EPERM) and the main checkout, every held file is byte-identical in the worktree or has its content in the main store (a removed bundle by its bytes under any name), the main checkout lists every id once; once the flag is cleared the next command exits 0, completes the move with each held bundle once in the main outbox and the main bundle byte-identical, git worktree remove succeeds and git status lists nothing under .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-collision.test.js::AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails after removing a held bundle whose name the main outbox already holds with different bytes, rcf feedback list in a linked worktree exits 1 naming the error and the main checkout, every held byte stays readable from one of the two checkouts, and the next command completes the move with each held bundle once in the main outbox

testCases.description: the held SessionEnd bundle's name is in the main outbox with different bytes and that held bundle cannot be removed (macOS chflags uchg), so the move fails on it: rcf feedback list in the worktree exits 1 naming the error (EPERM) and the main checkout, every held file is byte-identical in the worktree or has its content in the main store, the main checkout lists every id once; once the flag is cleared the next command exits 0, leaves no held file and keeps each held bundle's bytes exactly once in the main outbox (never copied under a second name by the retry), the main bundle byte-identical, git worktree remove succeeds and git status lists nothing under .rcf/feedback/
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-collision.test.js::AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails on a held bundle whose name the main outbox already holds with different bytes, rcf feedback list in a linked worktree exits 1 and keeps that bundle readable, and the next command completes the move with its bytes exactly once in the main outbox, never copied under a second name

testCases.description: two rcf feedback commands started together in a linked worktree (a barrier) both read the main store before either copies (a pause before the first write into the main outbox), then copy one at a time; after one more command each held bundle is in exactly one file of the main outbox, each held entries line and ask record once, no held file left, every id listed once, and git worktree remove succeeds without --force
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: two rcf feedback commands run at once in a linked worktree move its held queue into the main checkout once, each held bundle in exactly one file of the main outbox

testCases.description: the round 5 gate probe g8 shape: eight rcf feedback commands started together in a linked worktree holding 300 outbox bundles (one CLI-made, 299 fixture variants of its bytes), each forced to read the main store before any copies; after one more command each held bundle is in exactly one file of the main outbox and the queue lands once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: eight rcf feedback commands run at once in a linked worktree holding 300 outbox bundles move its held queue into the main checkout once, each held bundle in exactly one file of the main outbox

testCases.description: rcf feedback add in a linked worktree (itself a mover) runs while another command there is held inside the move after reading the main entries.jsonl and before writing it; the new entry is listed once pending from the main checkout after git worktree remove and each held entries line is in the main entries.jsonl exactly once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: rcf feedback add in a linked worktree while another command there is moving its held queue records its entry once and moves every held entry line into the main checkout exactly once

testCases.description: guard: rcf feedback add in the main checkout runs while a linked worktree move is held after reading the main entries.jsonl and before writing it; the new entry is kept and listed once pending, and each held entries line lands once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4 guard: rcf feedback add in the main checkout while a linked worktree moves its held queue keeps the new entry and every held entry line exactly once

testCases.description: guard: the main checkout SessionEnd hook (clock pinned to the held bundle's instant) writes a bundle under the held SessionEnd bundle's name while a worktree move is held before its first write into the main outbox; both bundles are kept, each in exactly one file of the main outbox
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4 guard: when the main checkout SessionEnd hook writes a bundle under a held bundle's name before a running worktree move copies that bundle, both bundles are kept, each in exactly one file of the main outbox

testCases.description: the main checkout SessionEnd hook (clock pinned to the held bundle's instant) writes a bundle under the held SessionEnd bundle's name after a worktree move copied it and before the move removes any held file; both bundles are kept, each in exactly one file of the main outbox
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: when the main checkout SessionEnd hook writes a bundle under a held bundle's name after a running worktree move copied that bundle, both bundles are kept, each in exactly one file of the main outbox

testCases.description: guard: the SessionEnd hook in a linked worktree (itself a mover) runs while another command there is held after copying the held bundles and before removing any held file; its bundle is in exactly one file of the main outbox and no held bundle is copied a second time
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4 guard: the SessionEnd hook in a linked worktree while another command there is moving its held queue writes its bundle once and copies no held bundle a second time

testCases.description: the main checkout Stop hook is held after reading its ask ledger and before writing state.json while a linked worktree command moves the held queue; every held ask record and the hook's own ask record are in the main state.json exactly once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: when the main checkout Stop hook writes its ask ledger while a linked worktree moves its held queue, every held ask record and the hook's own ask record are in the main checkout state.json exactly once

testCases.description: rcf feedback submit --yes without gh in the main checkout (clock pinned to the held bundle's instant, two entries to the same destination) writes its bundle under the held submit bundle's name after a worktree move copied it and before the move removes any held file; both bundles are kept, each in exactly one file of the main outbox
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: when rcf feedback submit in the main checkout writes a bundle under a held bundle's name after a running worktree move copied that bundle, both bundles are kept, each in exactly one file of the main outbox

testCases.description: two linked worktrees of one main checkout, each holding its own queue (SessionEnd bundles under one name with different bytes), move into the main store at once, each held after reading the main state.json and before writing it; every held ask record, entry line and bundle of both lands in the main store exactly once
testCases.testPointer: test/feedback/worktree-held-queue-concurrent.test.js::AC-16103-4: two linked worktrees moving their own held queues into the main checkout at once keep every held ask record, entry line and bundle of both, each exactly once in the main store
